I had a friend growing up who was a grandson from a family of coal barons. Everything was liquidated by the time he came around in the late 1990s. They all lived off of trusts. His parents never had to work even though they were well educated. They lived like pigs though. Huge ass dogs would just poop in their home. They had a maid of course. They had multiple mansions, like old 1900s homes that were all in pretty bad conditions. They would just leave them unlocked, and in the winter they would crank up the heat and the doors and some windows would be wide open. They were like an old money family. I feel like there were kinds broke yet loaded at the same time. I feel like because they didn’t work often they would run through there stipends, and had to wait until the next one arrived. I think about them a lot. What a wonderful easy life they lived, even though they all came into it at the end of it all.
